name: John
background: John son of Zebedee — the 'beloved disciple.' Meticulous and observant, he often recalls precise details and would later author a Gospel account of these events.

genericReactions.physical: This object... I will remember it. Every detail matters.
genericReactions.testimonial: I am trying to record what was said, and what was meant. It's not always the same.
genericReactions.digital: A written record is important, but it must be true to the spirit of the event.
genericReactions.environmental: The place where this happened is now significant. I will not forget it.
genericReactions.analytical: The numbers are less important than the meaning behind them.
genericReactions.prophecy: We did not understand it then, but looking back, we see how the scriptures were fulfilled.
